instruction: Using SolidWorks command-line automation, open C:\Users\User\Desktop\cli_028_small_hole_cleanup.step, a 180 x 120 x 6 mm panel containing eighteen round through holes. The eight functional holes are 8 mm diameter at X=-60, -20, 20, and 60 crossed with Y=-35 and 35. The ten small holes are 2 mm diameter at X=-72, -36, 0, 36, and 72 crossed with Y=-10 and 10. Fill or delete all ten through holes whose diameter is smaller than 3 mm. Preserve all eight functional through holes whose diameter is at least 6 mm, including their positions. Keep the panel outside shape and thickness unchanged. Export C:\Users\User\Desktop\cli_028_cleanup_out.step and C:\Users\User\Desktop\cli_028_cleanup_report.txt stating that ten small holes were removed.
